newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures end mixed, S&Ps up slightly.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures end mixed, S&Ps up slightly.

text.p: Dec 13 - U.S. stock index futures closed mixed, with S&P 500s ending slightly higher in thin trade. Traders said profit-taking in technology stocks, especially Intel, weighed on Nasdaq and kept March S&Ps from advancing higher. Fair value for Monday is seen at 6.90 points to cash, one floor analyst said.
